symbols.role: Immediate treatment assignment whose private randomization is excluded from the matching rule.

standard.name: Independent superpopulation draw used only for ex ante design risk

assumptions.condition: The density satisfies \(\underline f\le f(x)\le\overline f\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\).

standard.name: Density bounded above and away from zero on compact support
Supremum envelope for a Hölder class

assumptions.condition: At arrival \(t\), the store-or-match action and partner choice of \(\pi\) are \(\mathcal F_t^X\)-measurable functions only of \((X_1,\ldots,X_t,\xi)\), with no treatment assignments or pair-orientation signs as arguments.

Each \(Z_i\) is assigned when unit \(i\) arrives and is never revised: a stored arrival receives a private fair assignment, while an arrival that completes a pair receives the treatment opposite to the stored member.
Every action either inserts the current arrival into \(U_\pi(t)\) or pairs it with one member of \(U_\pi(t-1)\) and removes that member.

novel.justification: A deterministic cap represents fixed enrollment-hold capacity, privacy-limited retention, or a prespecified operational queue; the constraint is observable and enforceable at every arrival.

assumptions.condition: Under the deferred-randomization representation, after each edge is selected without using \((Z_i)_{i=1}^T\), draw its sign \(\varepsilon_k\); conditional on \((W_i)_{i=1}^T\) and \(\xi\), the signs \((\varepsilon_k)_{k=1}^{T/2}\) are independent Rademacher variables.

definitions.name: Endpoint-safe coarsening handle
definitions.construction: Begin with a fixed-branching dyadic partition having at most \(b\) leaves; pair arrivals within occupied current cells, merge siblings on a deterministic time-to-go schedule, and construct a phasewise workload potential that charges inherited residues and forced clearing across levels to derive \(\pi^\star\).

statements.statement: For every \(\pi\in\Pi_{T,B}\), conditional on \((W_i)_{i=1}^T\) and \(\xi\), \(\mathbb E_Z[\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}]=\tau_T\) and \[\operatorname{Var}_Z(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}})=T^{-2}\sum_{(i,j)\in M_\pi}(S_i-S_j)^2.\]
statements.justification: This exact randomization identity makes the finite-population causal target explicit before any ex ante minimax averaging.
statements.gap: \cite{morrison2025reservoir} gives a related conditional formula, but permits a final unmatched reservoir; the present identity is specialized to forced perfect pairs.
statements.consumer: It lets trialists interpret matching cost as assignment-variance loss for the finite-population ATE.

statements.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_{\beta,d}(L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\) and \(\pi\in\Pi_{T,B}\), \[T\,\mathbb E_{P,\xi}\!\left[\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M_\pi)\mid(W_i)_{i=1}^T,\xi\}-\min_{M\in\mathfrak M_T}\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M)\mid(W_i)_{i=1}^T\}\right]=T^{-1}\mathbb E_{P,\xi}[C_g(M_\pi)-O_g(X)].\] Consequently, \(R_T(B)\) is exactly \(T\) times the minimax ex ante expected design-variance excess over the offline prognostic oracle.
statements.justification: The reduction preserves both the causal estimand and Bai's scalar oracle rather than replacing it by Euclidean matching.
statements.gap: Bai's variance criterion is offline and Morrison's reservoir may retain unmatched units; neither yields this forced-empty hard-cap regret identity.
statements.consumer: The equality converts every frontier bound into a directly interpretable precision guarantee for the conditional IPW estimator.

statements.justification: The adjacent-order formula fixes the exact comparator retained in both lower and upper arguments.
statements.gap: This is the scalar squared-cost specialization of \cite{bai2022optimality}; recording it prevents drift to a Euclidean stand-in oracle.
statements.consumer: It makes the offline benchmark computable and bounds the oracle subtraction in the minimax converse.

statements.statement: There exists \(c>0\), depending only on \((d,\beta,L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\), such that for every even \(T\ge32\) and every \(B\ge1\), \[R_T(B)\ge cF_\alpha(T,b).\] The inequality holds against every randomized policy in \(\Pi_{T,B}\).
statements.justification: A weighted-suffix converse separates persistent capacity cost from the shrinking-partner deadline cost for all policies.
statements.gap: Online matching lower bounds in \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals} and \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} use competitive ratios or delay adversaries and do not retain the causal scalar-oracle subtraction.
statements.consumer: The converse tells investigators how much precision no reservoir implementation can recover at a specified cap.

statements.statement: For every integer \(1\le m\le b\), there exists an implementable covariate-only grid-parity policy in \(\Pi_{T,B}\) whose reservoir occupancy never exceeds \(m\), which empties at \(T\), and whose normalized worst-case regret is at most \(C\{m^{-\alpha}+m/T\}\). Consequently, \[R_T(B)\le C\inf_{1\le m\le b}\{m^{-\alpha}+m/T\},\] where \(C\) depends only on \((d,\beta,L,G,H)\).
statements.justification: This constructive baseline is already sharp whenever \(b^{1+\alpha}\le T\) and isolates the only missing deadline regime.
statements.gap: \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole} balances treatment signs immediately and has no stored-unmatched occupancy or terminal-clearing term.
statements.consumer: It supplies a simple implementable cap rule and establishes sufficiency of diverging memory even before the sharp endpoint lemma is closed.

statements.statement: Can the endpoint-safe coarsening handle in Definition \(\mathrm{def:coarsening-handle}\) be completed to derive a single implementable \(\pi^\star\in\Pi_{T,B}\) and a constant \(C<\infty\), depending only on the fixed envelopes, such that for every even \(T\ge32\), \(B\ge1\), and \(P\in\mathcal P_{\beta,d}(L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\), \[T^{-1}\mathbb E_{P,\xi}[C_g(M_{\pi^\star})-O_g(X)]\le CF_\alpha(T,b)?\] The construction must certify the hard cap and terminal emptying pathwise while deriving, rather than assuming, the clearance tail or an equivalent expected workload bound.
statements.justification: This is the genuine open content: adapted inherited residues must be cleared without a false independence or de-Poissonization step.
statements.gap: Ascher et al. use branching of order \(\log T\) without a cap, while Kanoria replenishes supply and delay-matching papers price waiting; none yields fixed-branching endpoint safety for this depleting reservoir.
statements.consumer: A solution closes the all-regime capacity frontier and gives SeqExpMatch-style software a principled forced-clearing schedule.

statements.statement: There exist constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), depending only on \((d,\beta,L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\), such that for all even \(T\ge32\) and \(B\ge1\), \[cF_\alpha(T,b)\le R_T(B)\le CF_\alpha(T,b).\] The upper inequality is attained by the implementable hard-cap policy \(\pi^\star\), and the lower inequality holds over all \(\Pi_{T,B}\).
statements.justification: The matched upper and lower bounds are the theorem-level design certificate: they identify the exact cost of memory and a common deadline.
statements.gap: No named comparator simultaneously imposes deterministic capacity, arrival-incidence matching, terminal perfect pairing, and additive causal precision regret over a Hölder class.
statements.consumer: Trial designers obtain a capacity calculator that is minimax-certified rather than tuned only by simulation.

statements.statement: The frontier theorem is equivalent, up to fixed constants, to \[R_T(B)\asymp\begin{cases}b^{-\alpha},&\alpha<1,\\ b^{-1}+T^{-1}\log(1+b),&\alpha=1,\\ b^{-\alpha}+T^{-1},&\alpha>1.\end{cases}\]
statements.justification: The three regimes display when capacity, multiscale deadline accumulation, or the mandatory final pair determines regret.
statements.gap: Adjacent papers report dimension-specific matching rates but do not derive this smoothness-by-dimension phase transition under a hard experimental reservoir.
statements.consumer: The regime table converts a theorem into sample-size and memory guidance for trial planning.

statements.statement: For every sequence of even horizons \(T\to\infty\) and capacities \(B_T\ge1\), \[R_T(B_T)\to0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad B_T\to\infty.\]
statements.justification: The iff statement identifies the exact memory-growth requirement for offline first-order precision.
statements.gap: Morrison gives one sufficient growing-reservoir schedule; necessity and the equivalence for arbitrary hard-cap schedules are not published.
statements.consumer: An experimenter can determine whether a proposed reservoir growth plan is asymptotically adequate without knowing \(g\).

statements.statement: For any \(P\in\mathcal P_{\beta,d}(L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\) whose \(g\) is constant on \(\mathcal X\), every \(M\in\mathfrak M_T\) satisfies \(C_g(M)=O_g(X)=0\); hence every feasible policy has zero per-law expected design-variance excess.
statements.justification: This reduction verifies that the frontier measures heterogeneous prognostic geometry rather than creating loss under a design-irrelevant score.
statements.gap: It is the homogeneous-score reduction implicit in offline matched-pair optimality and serves as a required internal consistency check.
statements.consumer: Applied users can verify that the cap is harmless when baseline prognosis is constant.

sampling_model.design: The store-or-match action and partner choice use only observed covariates and the auxiliary matching seed, never treatment assignments or orientation signs. Operationally, a stored arrival receives an immediate private fair assignment and a later completing arrival receives the opposite treatment. Conditional on the realized units and matching seed, treatment-blind matching makes this law identical to drawing one independent fair orientation sign after each pair is completed; the potential outcomes remain fixed.
sampling_model.units: An outer iid law for \((X_i,Y_i(0),Y_i(1))\) defines the minimax expected design risk and the unknown prognostic score; it is not used to replace the finite-population causal estimand.
sampling_model.treatment: Every unit is assigned at its arrival and the assignment is never revised. Exactly one unit in each arrival-incidence pair receives treatment and the other receives control; conditional on the completed matching, the pair orientations are independent and each has probability \(1/2\).
sampling_model.overlap: The known marginal treatment probability is \(1/2\) for every unit.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None. The policy observes covariates only and does not know or estimate \(g\); \(g\) indexes the law class and the offline precision oracle.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 1 identifies adjacent pairing after sorting \(g\) as MSE-optimal among half-treatment stratifications.
Theorems 1--2 give an offline-variance CLT for an uncapped packing reservoir with a negligible unmatched remainder.
Theorem 1 gives an \(O(\log^2 T)\)-competitive general-arrivals line-matching algorithm under unknown iid arrivals.
The pigeonhole theorem bounds geometric discrepancy for immediate cellwise treatment balancing without a reservoir.
Hierarchical Greedy attains dimension-dependent spatial matching rates with initial or replenished supply.
Tree embedding yields an \(O(\log n)\)-competitive algorithm for min-cost perfect matching with delays.
Covariate-close offline matched pairs admit asymptotically exact superpopulation ATE inference.
Offline matched tuples admit joint asymptotic normality and consistent covariance estimation for treatment contrasts.
Fixed-\(k\) matching with delays on \(H\)-metrics has an \(O(\log n)\) competitive ratio.

tldr: The target result characterizes the exact order of the precision loss caused by a hard unmatched-unit reservoir and a common enrollment deadline in online matched-pair randomization. Matching decisions use only covariate history; immediate private assignments admit an equivalent deferred representation in which every completed pair receives one independent fair orientation. Conditional on fixed potential outcomes, these orientations give an exactly design-unbiased IPW estimator, and averaging its assignment variance over the law class reduces the matching-dependent excess to \(R_T(B)\). The proposed theorem proves \(R_T(B)\asymp b^{-2\beta/d}+T^{-1}\sum_{r=1}^{b}r^{-2\beta/d}\), supplies a capped fixed-branching coarsening policy, and shows that offline first-order precision is attainable if and only if \(B_T\to\infty\). The lower bound and coarse policy have concrete proof architectures; endpoint-safe clearing in the deadline-dominated regime is the exposed open question.

project_justification.gap: Offline matched-pair theory identifies the prognostic-score oracle, and recent online reservoir work gives asymptotic sufficient conditions, but no result prices a deterministic reservoir cap jointly with forced terminal completion.
project_justification.niche: The missing object is an additive, finite-horizon capacity--deadline frontier for causal design variance, rather than a tuning heuristic, a competitive ratio, or a CLT that discards the unmatched remainder.
project_justification.fill: A weighted-suffix all-policy converse and a fixed-branching coarsening construction deliver matching orders, an implementable design certificate, and the iff memory rule.

related_work: \cite{bai2022optimality} supplies the offline oracle by showing that sorting the prognostic sum and pairing adjacent units minimizes conditional MSE among half-treatment stratifications. \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning} supplies the operational reservoir and the SeqExpMatch consumer, while leaving time- and occupancy-dependent tuning unresolved. Morrison's \emph{Reservoir Designs for Online Paired Experiments}, arXiv:2505.17247v1 (22 May 2025), defines covariate-determined reservoir matching in Section 2 and proves its packing-based asymptotic guarantees in Theorems 1--2; \cite{morrison2025reservoir} informs the variance reduction but allows a negligible unmatched remainder and is not a finite-cap or forced-empty comparator. Zhao and Zhou's \emph{Pigeonhole Design: Balancing Sequential Experiments from an Online Matching Perspective}, Management Science 71(3), 1889--1908, doi:10.1287/mnsc.2023.02184, supplies the cellwise partition and parity accounting, including the stopping-time decomposition in Theorem 6, but has no stored-unmatched occupancy or terminal clearing; see \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole}. \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals} supplies a coarsening proof for forced perfect matching under general arrivals, but its pool is uncapped and its objective is a line-metric competitive ratio. \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial} and \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} motivate multiscale charging under replenishment or delay prices, neither of which controls an adapted depleting reservoir at a fixed endpoint. \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference}, \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples}, and \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway} inform nonselected inference and multiarm extensions and are not theorem-level targets of the selected pairwise frontier.
technical_internal_limitation: The endpoint-safe clearance inequality is not established. The fixed-branching handle must control inherited cell workloads uniformly over the entire bounded-density class without treating multinomial cell counts as independent or invoking unquantified de-Poissonization. Exact finite-state diagnostics reproduced 691 weighted-suffix certificates through \(T=12\). Separate uniform-law simulations at \((d,\beta)=(1,1/2)\) and \((2,1)\) did not reject branching slack \(A=8\) through \(T=2048\), whereas \(A=4\) caused frequent early clearing in two dimensions. These computations are policy diagnostics only and do not support the theorem.
honest_scope: Every formal statement remains to be proved. The exact design-variance identity, adjacent scalar oracle, lower prior, weighted-suffix inequality, and coarse grid policy have explicit derivation paths that require independent checking. The full upper frontier depends on the open endpoint-safe coarsening question. No CLT, variance estimator, outcome-adaptive score learner, multiarm tuple frontier, exact leading constant, or guarantee for the response-adaptive CARA implementation is claimed. As a sanity reduction, a constant prognostic score makes every matching cost and every per-law variance excess exactly zero; the nontrivial minimax frontier arises from uniform performance over the Hölder class.

seed_details.kernel: For hard-cap arrival-incidence matched-pair designs, characterize the minimax expected design-variance regret by \(F_{\alpha}(T,b)=b^{-\alpha}+T^{-1}\sum_{r=1}^{b}r^{-\alpha}\), uniformly over every feasible \((T,B)\), and derive the iff memory-growth rule for offline first-order precision.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, Theorem 1, equation defining the oracle stratification, the conditional-MSE decomposition in its proof, the Hardy--Littlewood rearrangement lemma, and the Discussion of \cite{bai2022optimality}. The proof makes adjacent pairing after sorting the prognostic sum \(g\) the exact offline benchmark.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Bai's sorting step uses all covariates before assignment; the first changed step is to lower-bound and attain the excess scalar matching cost when a match may use only the current arrival and at most \(B\) earlier unmatched arrivals.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for ``sequential randomized experiment reservoir capacity matched pair regret'' and ``finite buffer online nonbipartite matching iid deadline'' found Morrison's uncapped packing CLT and Ascher et al.'s uncapped general-arrivals ratio, but no hard-cap causal frontier.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals} because its coarsening algorithm already handles forced terminal matches.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their theorem has no deterministic waiting-pool cap, treats linear distance on the line, and bounds a competitive ratio; its logarithmic branching does not imply a uniform additive frontier in \((T,B,\beta,d)\).
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The design is the decision variable and the result includes an all-policy converse and an attaining policy certificate, so this is M13 rather than a fixed-design CLT or an application-only seed.
adjacent_threads: \cite{morrison2025reservoir}: uncapped packing CLT with a negligible unmatched remainder.
\cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}: uncapped forced-completion coarsening and competitive ratio.
\cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial}: hierarchical spatial matching with replenished supply.

seed_details.kernel: Prove an endpoint-safe workload inequality for fixed-branching dyadic coarsening: inherited cell residues must clear before the common deadline with expected cross-cell Hölder cost of the same order as the weighted suffix lower bound.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, the Pigeonhole Design construction, Theorem 6 and its proof's stopping-time decomposition, and the limitations section of \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole}. Its cellwise parity calculation controls immediate assignment but has neither a waiting reservoir nor terminal emptying.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The first changed step is replacing treatment-count imbalance inside fixed cells by a pathwise workload process whose inherited residues can occupy several descendants after cells merge.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search paired ``endpoint clearing'' with coarsening, hard buffers, and general arrivals. Ascher et al. use large branching and Chernoff bounds; delay papers charge waiting time; neither gives the fixed-branching, density-uniform hard-cap inequality.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from the pigeonhole-design proof because every cell has at most one residual subject.
seed_details.rebuttal: After merging, a parent inherits multiple adapted residues, and a common deterministic deadline creates a selected suffix that the fixed-cell parity proof never controls.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed names the workload inequality and the attaining design certificate; it is not a qualitative algorithm suggestion.
adjacent_threads: \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}: phasewise forced-matching event under logarithmic branching.
\cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays}: tree-level charging against connection and delay costs.

seed_details.kernel: Derive a design-based limit law and uniform Wald coverage for the finite-population ATE when a hard-cap online policy produces random ordinary and terminal pairs.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, Proposition 1, Theorems 1--2, the packing construction, and their proofs in \cite{morrison2025reservoir}. The CLT discards a sufficiently small final reservoir asymptotically rather than forcing every unit into a terminal pair.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The first changed step is a conditional randomization CLT for an adapted random partition with all potential outcomes fixed; the published proof instead invokes superpopulation matched-pair asymptotics after showing an unmatched remainder is negligible.
seed_details.destination_search: Adjacent searches located offline matched-pair inference, generic covariate-adaptive inference, and Morrison's packing CLT, but no design-based coverage theorem for hard-cap forced-empty random blocks.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference} once average pair distance vanishes.
seed_details.rebuttal: That theorem assumes completed offline-close blocks under superpopulation sampling; it does not derive a finite-population assignment CLT for an adapted matching graph with a terminally selected suffix.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is a genuine M12 lane because the proposed limit must be derived from pairwise orientation and finite-population negligibility, not assumed from a sampling CLT.
adjacent_threads: \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference}: pairs-of-pairs variance correction and superpopulation matched-pair limit theory.
\cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning}: random matched and reservoir counts with simulation-based inference.
\cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole}: sequential assignment blocks generated from covariate cells.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize a cap-aware finite-horizon matching index in time remaining, occupancy, and local cell state, together with a constant-factor certificate against the minimax frontier.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, the matching-on-the-fly construction, estimator discussion, and the final Discussion of \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning}; the paper explicitly leaves the cutoff's dependence on study progress and reservoir size open.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The first changed step is a sufficient-state reduction for the Bellman recursion; the published rule calibrates a distance cutoff from accumulated distances without pricing the option value of the final reservoir slots.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches over dynamic thresholds found rematching heuristics and staggered-rollout dynamic programs but no threshold theorem for arrival-incidence geometric pairing under a hard cap and common deadline.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The threshold is just the Bellman minimizer of a standard finite-horizon Markov decision process.
seed_details.rebuttal: The geometric reservoir is an unordered continuous state; measurable threshold structure, state compression, and a frontier-relative certificate are not consequences of writing the Bellman equation.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed demands a structural characterization and certificate, not a heuristic dynamic program.

seed_details.kernel: Obtain an oracle inequality separating hard-cap geometry from delayed online estimation of \(g\), and pair it with martingale-valid ATE inference under outcome-to-design feedback.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, the covariate-weight learning construction, the simulation evidence on early instability, and the Discussion paragraphs on blockwise updates under delayed outcomes in \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning}.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The deterministic Hölder oscillation bound for accepted pairs must first be replaced by an online prediction-error inequality evaluated on adaptively selected reservoir pairs.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found response-adaptive sample splitting and adaptive ATE designs, but not a learning-plus-hard-cap decomposition for online pair formation.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from ordinary nonparametric regression rates plus the oracle capacity bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: Reservoir pairs are selected by the estimated score and delayed filtration, so ordinary risk does not control prediction error on selected edges or restore randomization inference.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The motif is M13+M14 because design regret and adaptive inference are both focal; it is not mislabeled as a bare M8 extension.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the hard-cap frontier for online \(q\)-unit tuples receiving every treatment once, including the dependence on residue vectors modulo \(q\) and terminal tuple completion.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, matched-tuples setup, Theorems 3.1--3.2, the conditional-array proof decomposition, and the recommendations section of \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples}. The paper assumes homogeneous offline tuples already exist.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Pairwise parity must first be replaced by a vector of cell residues modulo \(q\), and the capacity certificate must control incomplete tuples across coarsening levels.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination pair ``online \(q\)-way matching plus matched-tuples causal precision'' found \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway}, whose delay objective and \(H\)-metric have no hard capacity or common deadline.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate by replacing parity with residues modulo \(q\) in the pairwise proof.
seed_details.rebuttal: Tuple completion couples \(q-1\) deficit coordinates and the causal loss is a contrast covariance matrix, so neither the lower prior nor endpoint workload argument transfers mechanically.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is an optimal-design frontier, not a routine binary-to-multiple-treatment relabeling, because the first combinatorial invariant changes from scalar parity to a residue vector.
adjacent_threads: \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway}: reduction of an \(H\)-metric tuple cost to pairwise tree distances.
\cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning}: explicit multiarm online-matching direction without a theorem.
\cite{bai2022optimality}: optimal fixed treated-fraction strata formed by sorting an inverse-probability prognostic index.

seed_details.kernel: At \(d=1\) and \(\beta=1/2\), prove the sharp \(\Theta(\log T)\) total geometric cost at maximal usable capacity and identify whether cross-scale cancellation yields a limiting constant.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, Theorem 1, the algorithmic framework, the forced-matching event proof for the uniform-law warm-up, and the lower-bound discussion of \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}. Their known-iid line algorithm uses branching of order \(\log T\) and gives an \(O(\log^2 T)\) ratio.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The first changed step is to replace a union bound across large merged buckets by fixed-branching workload cancellation while preserving deterministic occupancy.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the uniform-line critical logarithm found only the gap between logarithmic and squared-logarithmic costs in adjacent dynamic-matching models.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This merely closes one logarithm in an online-matching special case.
seed_details.rebuttal: The hard-cap causal model yields a different additive oracle regret, but the one-dimensional critical slice alone is narrower than the full frontier and is therefore not selected.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed has a named critical logarithm and constant question, but its special-case scope limits ambition.

seed_details.kernel: For matching loss \(\|X_i-X_j\|^p\), derive the hard-cap phase diagram in \((p,d,B,T)\) and identify the macro-scale versus nearest-neighbor transition.
seed_details.anchor_read_receipt: Read the Introduction, the static and dynamic scaling theorems, the Hierarchical Greedy construction and correctness proof, and the Discussion's open direction for power costs in \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial}.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Kanoria's replenished supply lower boundaries must first be replaced by a depleting arrival-incidence reservoir whose last unmatched suffix has no replenishment.
seed_details.destination_search: Searching ``power cost hard buffer online spatial matching deadline'' did not reveal a finite-horizon hard-cap theorem; the closest sources study replenished supply or delay penalties.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The phase diagram is already implicit in Hierarchical Greedy's level-by-level sum.
seed_details.rebuttal: That sum relies on permanent supply lower bounds; a common terminal deadline introduces a weighted suffix term absent from the replenished model.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is a design frontier with a changed resource process, but it is less directly causal than the selected prognostic-score kernel.

literature_map: The selected seed sits between offline causal optimality and online general-arrivals matching. \cite{bai2022optimality} identifies adjacent pairing after sorting the prognostic sum \(g\) as the conditional-MSE-minimizing half-treatment design. \cite{morrison2025reservoir} gives an uncapped packing reservoir and a superpopulation CLT when its unmatched remainder is negligible, but it neither empties the reservoir nor characterizes finite-horizon regret. \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning} supplies the practitioner reservoir and explicitly leaves capacity- and time-dependent tuning unresolved. \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole} supplies the experiment-native cell-parity construction without waiting or terminal clearing. \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals} studies the same arrival-incidence matching primitive and proves forced completion with a large-branching coarsening algorithm, but it imposes no hard pool cap and uses a competitive-ratio objective. \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial} and \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} supply multiscale accounting under replenished supply and delay costs, respectively; neither controls a depleting capped reservoir at a common endpoint. For the surviving inference seed, \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference} and \cite{morrison2025reservoir} settle superpopulation matched-pair CLTs but not fixed-potential-outcome inference for adapted terminal blocks. For the surviving tuple seed, \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples} settles offline tuple inference and \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway} settles delayed \(k\)-way matching on \(H\)-metrics, leaving their hard-cap causal intersection empty.

novelty_justification: The closest causal result is \cite{morrison2025reservoir}: its packing policy is allowed a random unmatched remainder and yields an asymptotic sufficient condition, whereas the present kernel asks for a nonasymptotic minimax law for every hard cap and requires all units to belong to independently oriented pairs at the deadline. The closest matching result is \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}: it shares arrival-incidence perfect matching and forced completion, but has no deterministic occupancy constraint, studies linear line distance, and controls a ratio to offline cost rather than the additive prognostic-score regret that equals causal design-variance excess. The new mathematical object is the capacity--deadline frontier \(F_{\alpha}(T,b)\), whose suffix sum records the shrinking set of feasible partners. No closer source found in the anchor citations, citing threads, or target--method searches states either side of this frontier or the iff rule \(B_T\to\infty\).
